# DeSpain Consulting

> AI-powered operations consulting for small businesses and founders. We remove operational friction using AI systems tailored to how you actually work. Based in Park City, Utah, serving clients worldwide.

DeSpain Consulting was founded by Anne DeSpain, who brings 20+ years of retail operations experience from Amazon, Myer, Sundance Catalog, J.Crew, and Limited Brands. The firm specializes in helping purpose-driven brands and small businesses implement practical AI automation — not theoretical proofs of concept, but working systems that survive contact with the real world.

## Core Services

- **Process Automation** — Identify and eliminate repetitive manual work with AI-powered workflows tailored to your operations
- **Decision Visibility** — Real-time dashboards and automated reporting so critical data reaches the right people at the right time
- **Scaling Systems** — Design processes that support growth without proportional headcount increases
- **AI Strategy** — Cut through the hype and identify where AI genuinely moves the needle for your specific business

## Approach

Start with the problem, not the technology. Build for how you actually work — not generic solutions. Transfer knowledge to build internal capability, not ongoing dependency.

## Business Ventures

Active businesses that demonstrate the same principles applied to client work:

- [Wasatch Gift](https://wasatchgift.com): Curated artisan e-commerce featuring Utah local makers, gift personalization, and brand storytelling
- [mAIker](https://maikerco.etsy.com): Fashion-forward apparel and accessories on Etsy, with trend-responsive product development and marketplace optimization

## AI Systems Built

- **Magnolia** — Property management assistant for a historic Charleston property; integrates municipal databases, vendor tracking, and preservation compliance
- **College Scout** — Agentic research automation system for college exploration, handling multi-step research tasks across multiple sources ([try it](https://collegescout.vercel.app))
- **Print Marketing Guru** — Custom GPT providing benchmarks and KPIs for print marketing campaigns ([try it](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-675338a3335c8191a8148d87ed288630-print-marketing-guru))
- **Document Generation Workflow** — 55-step orchestration process with one main agent coordinating 7 specialized AI agents for complex document workflows
